content: Hi! How can I help you with your design files today?
Hey! Just checking if my client received the branding assets, I sent the link yesterday.
I see your shared folder here, and it looks perfect, everything's neatly organized! Would you like me to confirm the link is still view-only and active for your client?
Yes, please! I set it to view-only, but double-checking would be great.
All set, the access is view-only and expires in 7 days, so your client's info stays private. You can share <brand_assets_link> for them to browse and select files safely.
Thanks! Should I remind them to download the originals or just the previews?
I recommend they download the original files for best quality, especially if they plan to print or edit. The originals are clearly labeled in the folder, just one click to save them.
Good tip. I'll mention that. Is there a way to let me know if they add comments or need any adjustments?
Absolutely! If you enable notifications in the folder's settings, you'll get an alert when they leave feedback or request changes. Just visit the settings page to turn that on.
Perfect. Also, should I upload the alternate logo versions I drafted, or wait for their go-ahead?
If you have their consent, uploading the alternates now can speed up the process. Otherwise, you can keep them ready and add them later. All files in the folder stay private and view-only.
Understood. Thank you for helping me keep things organized and secure!
You're very welcome! Your attention to privacy and clarity is fantastic. Let me know if you want a summary of shared files, or if you need help exporting everything as a ZIP for easier downloading.
